response: Yes, orthostatic myoclonus is an underrecognized cause of unsteadiness. It is a rare movement disorder characterized by brief, shock-like muscle contractions that occur when a person is standing, leading to feelings of unsteadiness or imbalance. Due to its rarity and similarity to other conditions, orthostatic myoclonus is often misdiagnosed or underdiagnosed, making it an underrecognized cause of unsteadiness.
